seed: Somebody who finished the old one page setup window long ago, upgrading to the setup that goes one step at a time. The microphone and the screenshot keys are still not sorted on this Mac, but they saw those once already, so the only step they are shown is the new one: using Photonz from Claude Code and Copilot. Once. Then the menu bar's Welcome & Permissions still shows what is left whenever they ask. At Next defaults, no switch changed.

steps.note: an install that finished the old setup sees only the agents step, with no counter since it is the only one, and the line about doing it later from Settings
Skip closed the window and the next launch shows nothing: the agents step was seen once
Welcome & Permissions in the menu bar opens it again on what is still to do, and never asks about the tour
